summary: JIT grill of plan-approval-binding against current plans.py/factory_lib and the approved plan. Digest consistency, a single compare seam, and the save->approve->re-save flow resolved; contract kept.
current_flow: plans.py cmd_approve stores an approval marker with plan_sha256 = body_sha256(body); cmd_save requires a fresh --gate plan grill bound to the plan digest but cmd_approve does not; record_decomposition and stage start do not compare the live plan against the APPROVED digest, so an approved plan can be edited and silently re-legitimized on re-record. plan_digest_without_assumptions already binds decomposition/task grounding downstream.

criteria_map.an edited approved plan is refused at re: test_edited_approved_plan_refused_at_rerecord_and_stage_start edits an approved plan body and asserts both record_decomposition_from_json.py and stage start refuse until plan approve re-runs, via the shared require_approved_plan_digest helper comparing plan_digest_without_assumptions(live) vs the marker
criteria_map.plan approve refuses without a fresh pas: test_plan_approve_refuses_without_a_fresh_plan_grill asserts cmd_approve refuses when the plan grill is stale/absent/mismatched-digest, and the save(grill)->approve->re-save sequence still passes

new_abstractions: require_approved_plan_digest(root) in factory_lib - single seam that reads the approval marker + live plan and refuses on divergence; called by record_decomposition and stage start. Reversible: pure read+compare, reuses plan_digest_without_assumptions.

resolutions: Reuse plan_digest_without_assumptions everywhere (operator 2026-08-19): marker stores it; both refusal sites recompute+compare; appending an assumption keeps approval valid, a body edit invalidates it; the three sites cannot disagree.
One shared factory_lib helper (operator 2026-08-19): require_approved_plan_digest(root) called by record_decomposition and stage start - no duplicated drifting checks.

Preserve save->approve->re-save (operator 2026-08-19): cmd_approve checks the same fresh digest-bound plan grill cmd_save required; only a stale/absent/mismatched grill or edited plan is refused; existing plan_save/approve tests stay green.
